response.explanation_markdown:
**60,514.787 GJ** of mapped, observation-based energy proxy for **2026-07-24 to 2026-07-24** in **Selected area at 40.400°, -4.300°**. [6]

Regional temporal estimate: **60,514.787 GJ**, over **1 days**, including **0 reconstructed days**. Both fuse available sensors within each cell and use exact H3 areas; the map contains observations only. [6]

Derived dry biomass: **22,269.442 tonnes**, using 0.368 kg/MJ. This is a calibrated one-hour integration proxy from sparse satellite samples, not continuously measured heat release, burned area or measured emissions. [1]

Observed cell footprint: **545.872 km²**; selected polygon: **1,508.279 km²**. Available through **2026-07-24**. Industrial sources excluded.
